turns.question: How much revenue did we make per site session between 20 September and 3 October 2026?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no revenue-per-session metric; the closest figures are revenue of 7,172.59 EUR (revenue_eur, gross, non-cancelled orders) and 10 site sessions (site_sessions) for 20 September to 3 October 2026, and I have not divided one by the other.
